rejected_rule.statement: A premises is not governed by the Provisions of the Rent Act if the first assessment of the premises in suit is in excess of Rs.6000 /-
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In any event, as has been clearly proved at the trial and admitted by the defendant, the first assessment of the premises in suit was in excess of Rs.6000 /- and therefore undoubtedly the leased premises are not governed by the Provisions of the Rent Act.
